text:
mira: PR #5340 flagged during review: reference chat examples use a top-level "turns" array but the runtime and OpenAPI use "messages" now. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5340
jon: Ah yeah, I introduced "turns" in a quick doc rewrite a while back for readability. That diverged from the canonical schema. Linter caught it: example.rootKeyMismatch -> expected "messages"
olivia: For reader clarity, keep the examples simple: use "messages" in canonical JSON, but we can add a prose note that some older guides used "turns". Don't show both in the main example.
ryan: Also found a Ruby snippet that builds the request using symbol keys like `{ model: 'rwd-chat', turns: [...] }` which suggests to users that the API accepts symbols. We should change the snippet to show the JSON shape mapping comment: # JSON key: "messages"
mira: Proposed canonical curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain X"}],"max_new_tokens":50}'
```
jon: Good. And for the Ruby snippet, keep idiomatic hash but include an inline comment and show the body serialization to JSON explicitly so it's clear what keys are sent: `body = { model: 'rwd-chat-1', messages: messages }.to_json # JSON keys: model, messages, max_new_tokens`
docs-bot: CI: docs-lint raised example.keyMismatch and sample-type-check failures in samples/openapi/chat.yaml. Automated suggestion: update examples to match components/schemas/ChatRequest and add migration note.
olivia: I'll push a tiny patch to the PR replacing "turns" -> "messages" in examples and update the Ruby/TS snippets to include mapping comments. Also add a short migration note: "Legacy docs used `turns` — use `messages` instead. `turns` will be accepted as an alias for 7 days."
ryan: PTAL on branch olivia/chat-examples-casing. I also added a unit in docs CI to validate example JSON keys against the OpenAPI schema. If it passes here, we should catch future regressions.
mira: Reviewed and left a micro-nit on the migration paragraph. Once CI green I'll merge. Also add a changelog bullet: "docs: standardize chat request examples to 'messages' top-level key"
jon: After merge, I'll scan the docs repo for any remaining `"turns":` occurrences and open follow-ups for blog posts and tutorials.
docs-bot: Update: branch olivia/chat-examples-casing now passes docs-lint. Preview: https://deploy-preview-5340--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/chat
mira: Merged. Thanks all. Filing sdk follow-up: SDK teams should include a short mapping note in README for each language (INFR-439).
